lines.japanese: もういい、もし僕がこの世界に残ったとしても、グレタガルドに行けないんじゃどうしようもない。
lines.english: Enough. Even if I stayed in this world, if I couldn't go to Gretagard, there was no point.

lines.japanese: 今まで、自分が聖騎士ホーク・シアンブルーとして、この世界の自分は仮の姿だと思っていたからこその人生だったんだ。
lines.english: My life had only made sense because I believed I was the holy knight Hawk Cyan-Blue, and the me in this world was just a temporary guise.

lines.japanese: そうだ、この空っぽの物語は、公園にでも行ってふらりと消えてしまうだけの物語だったじゃないか。
lines.english: That's right. This empty story was only ever about me wandering off to some park and disappearing.

lines.japanese: 今さらなにかに縋ろうとするなんて、なにに期待をしてるっていうんだろう、僕は。
lines.english: Why reach for something now? What could I possibly still be hoping for?

lines.japanese: まあ……確かに残ってるかもしれないけど、未練。
lines.english: Well... I guess I might have some left after all. Attachments.

lines.japanese: 優しかったおじいさん。
lines.english: The kind old man.

lines.japanese: 可愛がってくれた叔父さん、叔母さん。
lines.english: My aunt and uncle, who'd always been so good to me.

lines.japanese: ようやく仲良くなって一緒に出かける約束をした、大切な小鳩。
lines.english: Dear Kobato. We had finally grown close and made plans to go out together.

lines.japanese: たった一人しかいなかったのに、今では両手の数ほども浮かぶ友達。
lines.english: I'd only had one friend before. Now I had almost enough to count on both hands.

lines.japanese: それと、もう一人、大事なひと。
lines.english: And one more person who mattered.
“...Haneda!”

lines.japanese: 僕の初恋のひと。
lines.english: My first love.

lines.japanese: 「羽田君！　おきて！　こら、おい！」
lines.english: “Haneda! Wake up! Come on—hey!”

lines.japanese: 「逃げないでよ！　いいかげん、帰ってきなさいっ！　このっ――」
lines.english: “Stop running away! That's enough. Come back here! You—”

lines.japanese: 世界に声が響く。
lines.english: A voice rang throughout the world.

lines.japanese: 「目ぇ、ひらけっ！」
lines.english: “Open your eyes!”

lines.japanese: 「えっ」
lines.english: “What?”

lines.japanese: 「ぶえうっ！」
lines.english: “Bwegh!”

lines.japanese: こ、れはっ……。
lines.english: Th-this was...

lines.japanese: 世界が開けた。
lines.english: The world opened.

lines.japanese: 僕の知っている場所、知っているひと。
lines.english: A place I knew. A person I knew.

lines.japanese: 大好きなひと。
lines.english: The person I loved.

lines.japanese: 「グー……パン？」
lines.english: “A... knuckle sandwich?”

lines.japanese: 顔のど真ん中に埋まっている柔らかい肌色。目を開いてよく見ると、グーに握った渡来さんの手だと分かった。
lines.english: Something soft and flesh-colored was jammed right into the middle of my face. When I opened my eyes and looked, I realized it was Watarai's balled-up fist.

lines.japanese: それに呼吸がしづらいと思ったら、渡来さんの細い指が僕の胸倉をつかんでいる。
lines.english: I was having trouble breathing too. Watarai's thin fingers had me by the collar.

lines.japanese: 「いったあ……」
lines.english: “Owww...”

lines.japanese: こっちが見てて心配になるくらい、小さく握った手を胸元に当てて身を縮める渡来さん。ひとをぶったこと自体が初めてなんだと思う、拳の部分が赤くなっていた。
lines.english: Watarai hunched up with her tiny fist held to her chest, looking so shaken I started to worry. It must have been the first time she had ever hit anyone. Her knuckles had turned red.

lines.japanese: 「いたい……お手てつぶれるかと思ったよね」
lines.english: “It hurts... I thought my poor little hand was gonna break.”

lines.japanese: 同意を求められても困る。僕だって鼻を潰されそうに……いや、もう潰れてるか。痛くないけど。
lines.english: What was I supposed to say to that? My nose was about to get flattened too... no, I guess it already was. Didn't hurt, though.

lines.japanese: 「やっと帰ってきた……」
lines.english: “You're finally back...”

lines.japanese: 彼女はさっきまで握っていた手をぱっぱと振って、ずいと僕の目の前まで迫ってきた。
lines.english: She shook out the fist she had used, then thrust her face right up to mine.

lines.japanese: 「まだやることいっぱいあるはずでしょ……早く戻ってきてよ」
lines.english: “You still have so much left to do... Hurry up and come back.”

lines.japanese: 渡来さんの物言いは、遠慮なんてまるで感じさせないはっきりしたものだった。思わず僕はあとずさりかけた。
lines.english: Watarai said it bluntly, without holding back at all. I almost stepped back without thinking.

lines.japanese: 「そんな……」
「ここに呼んだのは羽田君を突きおとすためじゃないし、逃避させるつもりも、全・然・ないっ！」
lines.english: “I didn't call you here to push you over the edge. And I have ab-so-lute-ly no intention of helping you escape!”

lines.japanese: 「女の子一人ほっぽって逃げだすなんて、違う世界に行くなら、せめて俺についてこいくらいの根性はないのか！」
lines.english: “Running off and abandoning a girl all by herself—if you're going to another world, haven't you at least got the guts to say, 'Come with me'?”

lines.japanese: 「だ、だって」
lines.english: “B-but...”

lines.japanese: 僕は怯みかけたけど、前にもこういうシーンがあって、そのときに求められた気質を思いだした。ごくりと唾を飲みこんで彼女と向きあう。
lines.english: I almost faltered. Then I remembered another scene like this, and the mettle she had demanded of me then. I swallowed hard and faced her.

lines.japanese: 「おれだって今まで自分が逃げてることさえ知らなかったんだ。そんなこと言われたって、まだ整理も付かないよ」
lines.english: “Until now, I didn't even know I was running away. You can't tell me something like that and expect me to sort it all out at once.”

lines.japanese: 「今までおれが自分の世界だと信じていたものがぜんぶ作りごとだったんだよ……今までずっと逃げてきたんだよ、ずっとずっと！」
lines.english: “Everything I believed was my world turned out to be something I made up... I’ve been running all this time. All this time, all this time!”

lines.japanese: 「おれが行くべき場所だと思っていた世界がなくなったなんて、これから先どうすればいいのかも分からない！」
lines.english: “The world I thought I was meant to reach is gone! I don't even know what I'm supposed to do now!”

lines.japanese: 僕はあとずさりかけた足を踏んじばって上体を起こした。渡来さんの顔と距離が近づく。
lines.english: I planted the foot that had begun to retreat and straightened my back. My face drew closer to Watarai's.

lines.japanese: 「違うよ」
lines.english: “You're wrong.”

lines.japanese: 渡来さんの目はまっすぐで、寸毫の怯みも見せなかった。だけど僕の胸をつかむ手だけが、微かに震えていた。
lines.english: Watarai met my eyes without the slightest flinch. Only the hand clutching my shirtfront trembled faintly.

lines.japanese: 「君は逃げてたんじゃない。今はそう思うかもしれないけど、でもいつか違うって気づくと思う」
lines.english: “You weren't running away. Maybe that's how it feels now, but someday I think you'll realize it isn't true.”

lines.japanese: 「私がそうだったから、羽田君にもそれを知っておいて欲しかったの。飛んだっていいんだよ。大切なのは、向こうの世界からなにを持ちかえるか」
lines.english: “I know because I was the same. That's what I wanted you to understand. It's all right to fly away. What matters is what you bring home from the other world.”

lines.japanese: 「持ちかえる……？　妄想の世界から、持ちだせるものなんて一つもないよ」
lines.english: “Bring home...? There's nothing you can carry out of a delusion.”

lines.japanese: 「そんなことないよ」
lines.english: “That isn't true.”

lines.japanese: 彼女はとても安らかな瞳で言った。
lines.english: Her eyes were very calm as she said it.

lines.japanese: 「だって羽田君の心の中には、いくつもの冒険があるんだよね。そこで手に入れた勇気や前向きさは、この世界にも必要なものだよ」
lines.english: “Your heart holds countless adventures, doesn’t it? The courage and optimism you found there are things this world needs too.”

lines.japanese: 「何かを持ちかえればそれは逃避行じゃなくて探索。翼を探す旅。羽田君も幾つかは楽園の宝を現実へ持ってきてるでしょ」
lines.english: “Bring something home, and it wasn’t an escape but an expedition—a journey in search of wings. You’ve already brought some of paradise’s treasures into the real world, haven’t you?”

lines.japanese: 楽園の宝……それはどんな敵をも切りさく剣でも、全てを打ちくだく上級魔法でもない。
lines.english: The treasure of paradise... It wasn't a sword that could cut through any enemy, or high-level magic that could smash everything to pieces.

lines.japanese: 「おれは……一人でいる自分を欺いて覆いかくすことしか……」
lines.english: “All I ever did... was deceive myself and cover up the fact that I was alone...”

lines.japanese: 「だったら必要ないよ。羽田君にはやることだってあるし、もう一人じゃないよね」
lines.english: “Then you don't need that anymore. You have things to do, and you aren't alone now.”

lines.japanese: 「卒業文集の製作、今だって先輩や山科がやってるんだよ。その完成を見なくていいの？」
lines.english: “What about the graduation anthology? Hariu and Yamashina are still working on it right now. Don't you want to see it completed?”

lines.japanese: 「私と同じ大学行くんだよね？　テストの点数、私より良かったじゃん。今からでも頑張れば受かるよ。まだ一緒に勉強すらしてないんだよ」
lines.english: “You're going to the same university as me, remember? Your test score was better than mine. If you start now and work hard, you can still get in. We haven't even studied together yet.”

lines.japanese: 渡来さんの視線が一瞬だけ部屋の隅に泳いだ。そこには大学に進むための赤い参考書や、問題集が並んでいる。
lines.english: For one instant, Watarai's eyes strayed toward the corner of the room. Red university-preparation guides and workbooks stood there in a row.

lines.japanese: その脇に何冊かの本が紐でくくられていた。。
lines.english: Several other books beside them had been tied together with string.

lines.japanese: その上には一通の手紙。この位置からでも不思議と文字がよく見える。
lines.english: A letter rested on top. Strangely, even from here I could make out the words.

lines.japanese: “合格しよう、羽田君！”
lines.english: ‘Let’s both pass, Haneda!’

lines.japanese: 小さなメッセージカードが、結ばれた紐に挟まっていた。
lines.english: A small message card was tucked beneath the string.

lines.japanese: 胸が熱くなる。
lines.english: Heat filled my chest.

lines.japanese: 彼女の残した小さな引っかき傷が、たしかな熱量を持って僕の心臓を脈打たせた。
lines.english: The tiny scratch she had left behind burned with a warmth that set my heart beating.

lines.japanese: わずかな未練が膨れて、涙腺を刺激する。
lines.english: That faint attachment swelled until it stung my eyes.

lines.japanese: 「だけど……」
だけど僕にはこの世界に残れる自信がないんだ。
lines.english: But I had no faith that I could remain in this world.

lines.japanese: 「だって、これから先もおれが生きていくとしたら、どこにも逃げ場所はないんだよ。グレタガルドには行けないんだよ」
lines.english: “Because if I keep living, there'll be nowhere left to run. I can't go to Gretagard anymore.”

lines.japanese: 「私だって逃げたいよ」
lines.english: “I want to run away too.”

lines.japanese: 胸を握っている手の力が緩む。襟元が寛ぐと喉が通りやすくなって、すうっと肺に空気が入っていった。
lines.english: The hand gripping my shirtfront loosened. My collar relaxed around my throat, and air slipped smoothly into my lungs.

lines.japanese: 「逃げてたんだよ。一人きりの家に閉じこもって、自分の話しやすい相手を作りあげて、誰にも関わらないようにして」
lines.english: “I did run. I shut myself inside an empty home, invented someone easy to talk to, and kept myself from becoming involved with anyone.”

lines.japanese: 「でもいつか大人になっちゃって、望まないまま明日夢には会えなくなって、私は一人で生きていくしかなくなったんだよ」
lines.english: “But somewhere along the way I grew up. Without ever wanting it, I lost the ability to see Asumu, and I had no choice but to go on living alone.”

lines.japanese: 「今だって逃げたいよ。都合の悪いことにも相槌を打って、言いたいこと言われても笑顔で返して、振る舞いたいようにも振る舞えないで」
lines.english: “Even now I want to run. I nod along with things I don't want to hear, smile back when people say whatever they like to me, and never get to act the way I want.”

lines.japanese: 「だけど明日夢に会うことすら出来なかったら、私はもっと、笑顔すら浮かべられない子どもになってたんだよ」
lines.english: “But if I hadn't even been able to meet Asumu, I'd have grown into a child who couldn't so much as smile.”

lines.japanese: 「羽田君だって持ってかえってきたはずだよ。この世界で過ごすために必要なもの、自分では気づいてないだけで、もう羽田君は持ってるんだよ」
lines.english: “You must have brought something home too, Haneda. Something you needed in order to live in this world. You just haven't noticed it, but you already have it.”

lines.japanese: 「……そんなこと」
lines.english: “...That can't be.”

lines.japanese: 僕がグレタガルドで見つけたもの……自分でも気づいてないものが、渡来さんには見えるんだろうか。
lines.english: Something I had found in Gretagard without ever recognizing it... Could Watarai see what it was?

lines.japanese: 「羽田君の気持ちが分かる」
lines.english: “I understand how you feel.”

lines.japanese: 「だって私もそうだったから！」
lines.english: “Because I was the same!”

lines.japanese: 僕の初恋のひと。そのひとが僕を理解してくれた。
lines.english: My first love. She understood me.

lines.japanese: ただひとり寂しいと言ってくれたひとが、誰よりも僕を引きとめてくれた。
lines.english: The one person who'd said she was lonely was the one trying hardest to make me stay.

lines.japanese: だけど僕が彼女と一緒にいるには、彼女はとても眩しかった。
lines.english: But she was too dazzling for me to stay by her side.

lines.japanese: 「でも、おれは……この先どうしたらいいか分からないんだ」
lines.english: “But I... I don't know what I'm supposed to do from here.”

lines.japanese: 「えっ」
lines.english: “What?”

lines.japanese: 「おれは渡来さんみたいに翼があるわけじゃないんだよ」
lines.english: “I don't have wings like you, Watarai.”

lines.japanese: 「だから、私はっ……」
lines.english: “I’m telling you, I...!”

lines.japanese: 渡来さんの手が僕の胸から離れた。彼女は自分の胸の前で、押さえるようにその手を合わせる。
lines.english: Watarai's hand left my chest. She brought both hands together before her own, as though holding something down inside.

lines.japanese: 「おれたちに……翼はないんだ」
lines.english: “We... don't have wings.”

lines.japanese: 僕はそのときの彼女の顔を確かめることなく、体を反転させる。
lines.english: I turned around without checking the look on her face.

lines.japanese: 最初の一、二歩はよろけたかもしれないけど、そのままなだれ込むようにこの部屋の出口に向かって駆けだした。
lines.english: I might've stumbled over the first step or two, but then I kept going and broke into a run for the door.

lines.japanese: 「羽田くんっ……」
lines.english: “Haneda...”

lines.japanese: 「つっ！　つう～……」
lines.english: “Ow! Owww...”

lines.japanese: 「手が……いたいよ……」
lines.english: “My hand... hurts...”

lines.japanese: 僕の顔に当てられた渡来さんの小さな手。叩いた側と叩かれた側では、どちらの痛みが大きいんだろうか。
lines.english: Watarai's small hand, the one that had hit my face. Which hurt more—the one who hit, or the one who got hit?

lines.japanese: 扉を開くと、そこにはなんの変哲もない１２月の空が広がっていた。
lines.english: When I opened the door, I saw an ordinary December sky.
